title: task-management
subHeroTitle: Plan, assign, and track work — without the chaos.
subHeroDesc: KeilHQ keeps every task clear and every team member accountable. Work moves forward because nothing can be marked done until its blockers are resolved.

sections.title: See your work from any angle
sections.desc: Switch between a calendar, a list, a board, or a progress tracker — whatever helps you think. All views stay in sync so you never lose context switching between them.

gridItems.title: Calendar view
gridItems.desc: See your team's work laid out day by day, week by week. Great for spotting overload before it becomes a problem.

gridItems.title: List view
gridItems.desc: A clean, filterable list of everything on your plate — organized by day, week, month, or however you need it.

gridItems.title: Kanban board
gridItems.desc: Drag tasks from To Do to Done across a visual board. Everyone can see exactly what's in progress and what's next.

gridItems.title: Track view
gridItems.desc: A live progress view showing what's moving, what's stalled, and what changed — without needing to ask for a status update.

sections.title: Full task details without leaving your flow
sections.desc: Click any task and get the full picture in a side drawer — who owns it, what's blocking it, when it's due — without losing your place in the board.

gridItems.title: Task details sidebar
gridItems.desc: Review the full task — owner, due date, priority, status — in a slide-over panel that keeps your board in view.

gridItems.title: Quick edit popup
gridItems.desc: Make fast updates to any task right from the list or board. No need to open a new page just to change a priority or due date.

sections.title: The full story behind every task
sections.desc: Every task has a dedicated page with full context — updates from the team, a log of every change ever made, and a clear view of what it depends on.

gridItems.title: Team activity log
gridItems.desc: Everyone working on a task can leave updates, notes, and progress comments in one place — no more scattered Slack threads.

gridItems.title: AI summary
gridItems.desc: Ask AI to summarize all the updates on a task and get a clean, one-paragraph overview of where things stand.

gridItems.title: Blocker dependencies
gridItems.desc: Link tasks together so that dependent work can't be closed until the prerequisite is done. No accidental early sign-offs.

gridItems.title: Full change history
gridItems.desc: Every edit — status change, reassignment, due date shift — is recorded automatically. Always know what changed and when.

sections.title: Your calendar and your tasks, finally in sync
sections.desc: Tasks with deadlines automatically appear on your Google Calendar. Your AI assistant can find open slots and schedule work for you, so nothing gets missed.

gridItems.title: Two-way Google Calendar sync
gridItems.desc: Tasks with due dates show up in Google Calendar automatically. Changes on either side stay in sync — no manual updating.

gridItems.title: AI smart scheduling
gridItems.desc: Tell the AI which tasks need time blocked and it'll find open slots in your calendar and schedule them for you.

gridItems.title: One-click Google Meet links
gridItems.desc: Schedule a team sync from a task and the Meet link gets generated automatically — no need to open Google Calendar separately.

capabilitiesDesc: KeilHQ unifies task tracking, strict dependency logic, native integrations, and granular audit history in one high-performance workspace.
checklistTitle: Work that stays organized, even when things get busy
checklistDesc: KeilHQ keeps every task clear and every team member accountable — without the overhead of manual status meetings.
checklistItems: See exactly what's in progress, what's blocked, and what's next — across any view that works for your team.
Nothing gets marked done until its blockers are resolved. Work moves forward in the right order, every time.
Tasks automatically appear on your Google Calendar. No double-entry, no missed deadlines.
Every change to a task — who changed it, when, and what — is recorded automatically. Full accountability, zero effort.
Let AI find open slots in your calendar and schedule unscheduled work for you.
Recurring work like weekly standups or monthly reviews can be automated so you never have to set them up twice.
